name: Vril
errataTitle: Drow of the Underdark Errata: The Vril Warrior
sourceDistinctions: The 2007 book provides the playable traits and refers to the stat block. The official errata supplies the omitted stat block and ability text.
Shriek’s level-3 stat block says 2d6, consistent with the written increase at 3rd and every three levels. Later examples conflict. This profile applies the written progression up to the 4d6 cap.
The Small carrying-capacity sentence is malformed. This profile uses the core Small multiplier of three-quarters.
Level adjustment is treated as +0 because the playable list gives no adjustment and the sample has only three class Hit Dice.
The −4 against drow and spiderkind poisons is corroborated by both the published Drow Slayer feat and the errata stat block.
portraitForm: Skriv Ashstripe, an original Vril ledge scout
